gold.taskTitle: Fix the dripping kitchen tap finally
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to stop their kitchen tap from dripping and resolve the issue for good.

questions.title: What type of tap is it: mixer, separate, or cartridge?
questions.description: Identify the tap type to determine the correct repair approach.

questions.title: How long has the tap been dripping?
questions.description: Understand the duration to assess potential water damage or urgency.

questions.title: Have you attempted any repairs on it before?
questions.description: Know the repair history to avoid repeating failed approaches.

questions.title: Do you plan to fix it yourself or hire a plumber?
questions.description: Clarify the execution approach to tailor the plan accordingly.

questions.title: Do you know the tap brand or model number?
questions.description: Identify the brand or model to source the correct replacement parts.

questions.title: What tools do you currently have at home?
questions.description: Assess available tools to determine what needs to be sourced before starting.

questions.title: What is your deadline or urgency for this fix?
questions.description: Establish a timeline to prioritise and schedule the repair appropriately.
